title: Music made of several sound clips plays without dropping out where they meet
goal: In an exported video whose music is made of short sound clips laid end to end, the sound went silent for most of a second just before one set of clips handed over to the next, although the sound files themselves have no silence. Sound clips that meet must play straight through, in playback and in export.
notes:
User, 2026-11-26: "I tried making one this morning. it was boring, the transitions were a bit buggy (e.g. 3d transitions wouldn't fade in and would immediately cover content, text would be clipped in weird spots, the transitions were dull). I don't see anything queued or done with improving the features and quality to make amazing sizzle reels (with a bunch of music presets that can create epic build ups and intensity and draw emotion)." 

The source .caf loops have no silence (silencedetect finds none). The 14 to 17 s video clip had set_speed 200 applied before export, which shortened it to 15.5; sound tracks were not touched. Related, not the same: the-sound-of-the-whole-reference-edit-plays-with (p2, playback dropouts measured once a second); if that task's measuring tool is built, reuse it.
acceptance: Reproduced first: the edit in queue/audits/2026-11-26-sizzle-intake/README.md (Apple Loops Mega Anthem Synth 2 at 0, 7.5, 15 and Four Four Beat at 7.5, 11.25, 15, each on its own audio track as Add Media at Playhead puts them) exported to MP4: ffmpeg silencedetect at -45 dB finds 14.36 to 15.04 s silent. Find which clip stops early and why (a sound clip's length rounded, an audio read ending short at a later track's start, a speed change on the video clip at 14 s shifting sound, or the mix itself) and write the cause in the audit with evidence.

Bar: in export and in playback (sample the output the way the-sound-of-the-whole-reference-edit-plays-with measures it), no stretch over 10 ms quieter than -45 dB anywhere a sound clip is playing, across clips that meet on one track and on different tracks, at the edit's own times and after a speed change elsewhere in the edit.
A test that fails on today's code. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.
